svg.title: For a higher coefficient h in mode A, split real and imaginary parts into two leaves with charges 1, i. If |h| ≤bA, their combined price is 2tw(A)bA. Coefficientwise scope, locality and permissions remain. Include only modes nonzero somewhere. A correction budget f becomes at most 2f. Dormant regular slots of zero original coefficient exist for every nonempty support, and forced slots for every admissible nonempty inventory with exact eligibility. Place exponential and flagged corrections in these respective slots. Nonzero higher corrections have at least two scoped markers and hence nonempty support. Together both families cost at most 4f, using this explicit history property: the existence of these dormant dictionary slots is part of the history construction. Their primary sum is P v e{v}(Φv −νv)+P S HS; the forced sum is P v e{v}ωv(q)+Kq. Higher leaves have no singleton quote. Occupancy converts singleton root budgets to M siteFactor(B)d; with 4f this is the numerical budget T.
